slot.brief: Mixed alpha-numeric series where each term has a letter block and a number block following separate rules; find the next (or missing) term.

stem:
Find the next term in the following alphanumeric series:
C5W, F11T, I19Q, L29N, ____

verdicts.working: First letters C,F,I,L advance +3 → O. Numbers 5,11,19,29 have differences 6,8,10 → next difference 12 gives 41. Last letters W,T,Q,N go −3 → K. Next term: O41K.

working:
The given series is composed of three components in each term: a first letter, a middle number, and a final letter.

1. **First letter:**
$\text{C} (3) \xrightarrow{+3} \text{F} (6) \xrightarrow{+3} \text{I} (9) \xrightarrow{+3} \text{L} (12) \xrightarrow{+3} \text{O} (15)$

2. **Middle number:**
$5 \xrightarrow{+6} 11 \xrightarrow{+8} 19 \xrightarrow{+10} 29 \xrightarrow{+12} 41$
The differences between consecutive numbers increase by $+2$ each time ($+6, +8, +10, +12$).

3. **Final letter:**
$\text{W} (23) \xrightarrow{-3} \text{T} (20) \xrightarrow{-3} \text{Q} (17) \xrightarrow{-3} \text{N} (14) \xrightarrow{-3} \text{K} (11)$

Combining the three components gives the next term: **O41K**.
